svg.title: SVG Image created as ghost-fader-2x2 gain matrix and summers.svg date 2026/09/09 20:14:12

g.style: fill:#000000; fill-opacity:1.0000;stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:1.0000; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;fill-rule:evenodd;

g.style: fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: Summers: two 10k resistors into the + input make a passive 1/2 mix; the non-inverting x2 stage restores unity.

g.desc: Summers: two 10k resistors into the + input make a passive 1/2 mix; the non-inverting x2 stage restores unity.

g.text: When one path is muted its PGA output sits at 0 V, so the other still comes through at unity.

g.desc: When one path is muted its PGA output sits at 0 V, so the other still comes through at unity.

g.text: Bypass, one per supply pin: U3 / U4 VA+, VA-, VD+; U5 V+, V-. C14 bulk on the +5VA logic rail beside U3.

g.desc: Bypass, one per supply pin: U3 / U4 VA+, VA-, VD+; U5 V+, V-. C14 bulk on the +5VA logic rail beside U3.

g.text: U3 = direct paths (L->L on its left channel, R->R on its right). U4 = cross paths (L->R on its left channel, R->L on its right).

g.desc: U3 = direct paths (L->L on its left channel, R->R on its right). U4 = cross paths (L->R on its left channel, R->L on its right).

g.text: SPI chain: XIAO MOSI (D10) -> U8 isolator -> U3 SDI, U3 SDO -> U4 SDI. 32 clocks per update: U4 word first, then U3; each word is right byte then left byte, MSB first.

g.desc: SPI chain: XIAO MOSI (D10) -> U8 isolator -> U3 SDI, U3 SDO -> U4 SDI. 32 clocks per update: U4 word first, then U3; each word is right byte then left byte, MSB first.

g.text: ZCEN high: gain changes wait for a zero crossing. Code 192 = 0 dB, 0 = mute. Logic supply is +5VA from U10 (sheet 5), on the audio ground; SDO stays on this side.

g.desc: ZCEN high: gain changes wait for a zero crossing. Code 192 = 0 dB, 0 = mute. Logic supply is +5VA from U10 (sheet 5), on the audio ground; SDO stays on this side.
